def run(session, query, top_k):
    import re

    # Split query on ' and ' or commas, strip whitespace
    parts = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r'\s+and\s+|,', query) if p.strip()]

    results = []

    for part in parts:
        # Decide mode based on keywords in part
        part_lower = part.lower()

        # Heuristic: if part mentions entities like 'title', 'named', 'name', 'who', 'which', 'what' -> use fielded query
        # else if part is generic or descriptive -> use hyde_search
        # else use hybrid search

        # Named entity hints
        named_entity_keywords = ['title', 'name', 'named', 'who', 'which', 'when', 'where', 'what', 'actor', 'publisher', 'politician', 'cities', 'novel', 'series', 'box set', 'composer', 'film', 'song', 'season', 'team']

        if any(k in part_lower for k in named_entity_keywords):
            # Use fielded query on title and text
            try:
                res = session.store.query_fielded(part, ['title', 'text'], top_k=top_k)
            except Exception:
                # fallback to hyde_search if error
                res = session.hyde_search(part, top_k=top_k)
        else:
            # Use hybrid search for general queries
            try:
                res = session.search(part, top_k=top_k, mode='hybrid')
            except Exception:
                # fallback to hyde_search if error
                res = session.hyde_search(part, top_k=top_k)

        results.append(res)

    # Always add a hyde_search pass for coverage
    try:
        hyde_res = session.hyde_search(query, top_k=top_k)
        results.append(hyde_res)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Fuse all result sets with RRF
    fused = session.fuse(results)

    return fused

def run(session, query, top_k):
    import re

    # Split query on ' and ' or commas, strip whitespace
    parts = re.split(r'\s+and\s+|,', query)
    parts = [p.strip() for p in parts if p.strip()]

    results = []

    for part in parts:
        # Heuristic: if part mentions entities like 'actor', 'publisher', 'title', 'novel', 'series', 'box set', 'politician', 'composer', 'cities', 'features', 'career', 'season', 'film', 'song', 'album', 'documentary', 'session', 'windstorm', 'project', 'village'
        # then treat as named entities -> use query_fielded on ['title','text']
        # else treat as generic description -> use hyde_search
        # always include a hybrid search for coverage

        part_lower = part.lower()

        named_entity_keywords = [
            'actor', 'publisher', 'title', 'novel', 'series', 'box set', 'politician', 'composer',
            'cities', 'features', 'career', 'season', 'film', 'song', 'album', 'documentary',
            'session', 'windstorm', 'project', 'village', 'player', 'director', 'musical',
            'documentary', 'legislative', 'power metal', 'connection', 'focus', 'heritage'
        ]

        is_named_entity = any(k in part_lower for k in named_entity_keywords)

        # Run searches
        res_sets = []

        # Named entity search
        if is_named_entity:
            try:
                res_sets.append(session.store.query_fielded(part, ['title', 'text'], top_k=top_k))
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Hybrid search (dense + keyword)
        try:
            res_sets.append(session.search(part, top_k=top_k, mode='hybrid'))
        except Exception:
            pass

        # HyDE search for generic coverage
        try:
            res_sets.append(session.hyde_search(part, top_k=top_k))
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Fuse results if multiple
        if len(res_sets) > 1:
            fused = session.fuse(res_sets)
            results.append(fused)
        elif res_sets:
            results.append(res_sets[0])

    # Fuse all parts results if multiple parts
    if len(results) > 1:
        final = session.fuse(results)
    elif results:
        final = results[0]
    else:
        final = None

    return final
